response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with strong backend, distributed-systems adjacent, and DevOps experience, plus notable geospatial exposure through GISCollective. However, his recent career has moved firmly into TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and AI-agent tooling, with C++ experience limited to a single role over a decade ago and no current Rust experience. The role's core requirement of modern C++ or Rust for a routing tiling pipeline is not well matched by his active skill set.
strengths: Deep geospatial domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map GIS projects
Strong distributed systems, microservices, and high-throughput/low-latency backend experience (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
Demonstrated systems-level programming background (DLang, C, C++) and DevOps/CI infrastructure skills
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (only ~6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015)
No listed Rust experience at all
Current role (re:cinq) and most recent years are focused on TypeScript/Node.js and AI tooling, not systems-level routing/navigation work

key_factors.factor: Strong distributed systems and low-latency infrastructure experience
